name: UBC open data
how_to_read: Index of every table in this dataset. One entry per table, not per file: `json` and `csv` hold the same rows, the JSON keeping nested values intact and the CSV encoding them into the cell. `grain` says what a single row is, `columns` describes the ones worth knowing about (not always all of them), and `joins` names the other tables a row can be linked to and on which column. Start here rather than guessing from filenames. manifest.json has the same information plus per-file sizes, sources and run status.

geospatial.title: Campus geospatial open data
geospatial.description: Buildings, building entrances, sub-buildings, complexes, addresses, points of interest, parking facilities with rates and permits, trees, hard/soft landscape, water features, roads, routes, bollards, land use, neighbourhoods and legal boundaries for UBC Vancouver, UBC Okanagan and off-campus UBC locations.

spaces.title: Learning spaces (classrooms, study space, bookable rooms)
spaces.description: Bookable classrooms and informal study spaces with capacity, building code, room number, photos and links, the per-building formal/informal room counts, and the full filter vocabulary UBC records for a space (A/V, accessibility, furniture style, room features).

tables.name: buildings
tables.grain: one building with teaching or study space, and the rooms in it

columns.rooms: the rooms collected for this building, floor order then largest first: name, room_number, floor, capacity, space_type, cover_photo_url, room_link
columns.Formal Count: UBC's own classroom count for the building
columns.Informal Count: UBC's own informal count, same caveat
columns.floors: distinct floors with a space on them, ascending
columns.largest_room_capacity: the biggest room in the building
columns.cover_photo_url: the largest room's first image. EXPIRES -- see cover_photo_expires
columns.cover_photo_expires: when that URL stops working, UTC
columns.cover_photo_room: which room the cover photo is of
columns.formal: which tab the building record was first seen on; not a property of the building -- use formal_collected/Formal Count instead

tables.name: rooms
tables.grain: one bookable classroom or informal study space

columns.Name: short name, e.g. `AERL 120`
columns.Title: room title as Find a Space shows it
columns.Building Code: e.g. `SWNG`; the building this room is in
columns.Room Number: room number within the building, verbatim
columns.floor: derived: -1 basement, 0 ground, 1 and up. Null where UBC's number does not say -- IRC and FNH number rooms on schemes of their own and are left null rather than guessed
columns.floor_source: `stated` if UBC wrote the floor in words, `room_number` if it came from the leading digit, null if unknown
columns.formal: true for bookable classrooms, false for informal study space
columns.photo_count: how many images UBC publishes for the room
columns.cover_photo_url: first image. A SIGNED URL THAT EXPIRES -- see cover_photo_expires
columns.cover_photo_thumbnail_url: the ~768px version of the same image
columns.cover_photo_id: Airtable attachment id; stable, unlike the URL
columns.Room Link: the page for this room. The durable way to an image -- it re-renders a fresh signed URL on load
columns.Image Gallery: every image, with all thumbnail sizes, as UBC returns it

events.title: UBC events calendar
events.description: Public events with start/end times, cost, website, description and category, plus the venue directory (street address, city, coordinates) and the organizer directory (contact email, phone, website).

tables.name: events
tables.grain: one public event

columns.title: event title
columns.all_day: true for all-day events, where the times mean nothing
columns.cost: as published; free text, often empty or `Free`
columns.venue: the venue object, inlined; `venue.id` joins to the venue table
columns.is_virtual: true for online events, which have no useful venue

tables.name: events.ics
tables.grain: one public event

columns.title: event title
columns.all_day: true for all-day events, where the times mean nothing
columns.cost: as published; free text, often empty or `Free`
columns.venue: the venue object, inlined; `venue.id` joins to the venue table
columns.is_virtual: true for online events, which have no useful venue

tables.name: venues
tables.grain: one venue in the events directory

columns.city: city -- the only campus proxy events have

joins: address ~ geospatial/ubcv/locations (no coordinates here; join to place on a map)

admissions.title: Admissions: degree and program finder
admissions.description: Every undergraduate program in UBC's program finder with its degree, campus, faculty, areas of interest and links, the degree list, and the you.ubc.ca content pages covering admission requirements, costs, deadlines and how to apply.

tables.name: programs
tables.grain: one undergraduate program in the program finder

columns.id: you.ubc.ca post id -- the key everything else here joins on
columns.degrees: degree term ids; resolve against degrees.json
columns.campuses: campus term ids; resolve against campuses.json
columns.interests: interest term ids; resolve against interests.json
columns.topics: topic term ids; resolve against topics.json

tables.name: by_location
tables.grain: one requirement group as it applies to one curriculum location

columns.curriculum: province, countries or ib -- which dropdown the location came from
columns.location: the province, country or IB, as UBC names it
columns.location_slug: stable identifier for the location, e.g. `british-columbia`. Pair it with `curriculum` -- `basic` is a slug in both the province and the country list and means a different thing in each
columns.location_term_id: UBC's term id for the location; unique on its own, null only for the IB row
columns.available: false when the program is not open to students from there
columns.specific_name: the degree the rules are stated for
columns.general: general admission rule (graduation, minimum English grade...)
columns.minimum: degree-specific rule where UBC states no grade bands
columns.recommended_grade_range: the grade range UBC says is competitive. The field exists upstream but came back empty on all combinations, so expect null
columns.suggested_subjects: subject areas UBC recommends but does not require
columns.profile_note: extra note UBC attaches to this location

tables.name: locations
tables.grain: one curriculum a student can apply from

columns.term_id: UBC's term id; null for the IB row, which is not a taxonomy term
columns.slug: stable identifier, e.g. `british-columbia`; `basic` is the fallback UBC applies when a location is not listed separately. NOT unique on its own -- `basic` exists in both the province and country taxonomies, so key on (taxonomy, slug) or on term_id
columns.name: display name

joins: (taxonomy, slug) -> requirements/by_location.(curriculum, location_slug), with `requirement_` stripped from the taxonomy name

tables.name: program_requirements
tables.grain: one undergraduate program in the program finder

columns.program_id: you.ubc.ca post id; joins to admissions/programs.json `id`
columns.program: program name as the finder lists it
columns.degrees: degree names this program leads to
columns.requirement_key: the requirement group this program uses; null if it has none
columns.has_requirements: false for graduate-entry and second-degree programs which publish no direct-entry rules
columns.note: why requirements are absent, when they are

tables.name: required_courses
tables.grain: one requirement line -- the exploded form of by_location, and the table to query when the question is 'what do I need to have taken?'

columns.curriculum: province, countries or ib -- which dropdown the location came from
columns.location: the province, country or IB, as UBC names it
columns.location_slug: stable identifier for the location, e.g. `british-columbia`. Pair it with `curriculum` -- `basic` is a slug in both the province and the country list and means a different thing in each
columns.location_term_id: UBC's term id for the location; unique on its own, null only for the IB row
columns.program_group: the degree the requirement is stated for
columns.kind: grade_12, grade_11, minimum, general, english_language, suggested_subjects or recommended_grade_range
columns.position: order within its kind, as UBC lists it
columns.advisory: true for suggestions and grade ranges; false for hard requirements

tables.name: requirement_groups
tables.grain: one set of degree-specific requirements, shared by every program that uses it

columns.requirement_key: UBC's slug for the group, e.g. `engineering`
columns.name: the name UBC shows, e.g. `Applied Science (Engineering)`
columns.programs: program names mapped to this group
columns.locations: how many curriculum locations returned rules for this group

courses.title: Course Schedule (courses, sections, instructors, meeting times)
courses.description: Every course and scheduled section published on UBC's Course Schedule, including meeting days and times, start/end dates, instructors, credits, delivery mode, instructional method and section status, plus the subject, campus, term and department code lists they reference. A derived `campus` column is added to courses and sections.

tables.name: courses
tables.grain: one course as offered in one academic year -- NOT one distinct course. Deduplicate on field_course_code for the catalogue

columns.field_course_code: e.g. `CPSC_V 110`; the `_V`/`_O` suffix is the campus
columns.field_course_instance_id: why one course has several rows: one instance per year
columns.body: description prose, prerequisites written into it
columns.description_text: derived: the description with the requirement prose removed
columns.prerequisite: derived from `body`; UBC's own prerequisite field is empty
columns.campus: derived: vancouver or okanagan. The API serves both with no campus field
columns.alias: path on courses.students.ubc.ca; prefix the host for the URL

tables.name: sections
tables.grain: one scheduled section of one course in one term -- the actual offering

columns.field_instructors: who teaches it. Names only; `courses` has no instructor field
columns.field_start_time: SECONDS after midnight, e.g. 55800 = 15:30. Not a clock string

joins: field_instructors ~ people/profiles.title (by name; there is no shared id)

calendar.title: Academic Calendar (course catalogue, programs, faculties, deadlines)
calendar.description: Official course catalogue entries with descriptions and credit values, plus prerequisites, corequisites, equivalencies, credit exclusions and hours vectors parsed out of the description prose; every calendar page with its body text, place in the hierarchy and the courses it references; the degree and specialization requirement pages on their own; the term dates and drop deadlines; and the faculty, school, department and subject hierarchy for both campuses.

tables.name: courses
tables.grain: one course in the catalogue -- what a course IS, not when it runs. Join to courses/sections for offerings

columns.field_course_description: the description, with requirement prose inside it
columns.description_text: derived: the description with that prose removed
columns.prerequisite: derived from the description; UBC's own field is empty on every row
columns.alias: path on the calendar host; prefix the host for the URL

tables.name: dates
tables.grain: one dated event -- a term boundary, exam period or drop/withdrawal deadline

columns.event: what happens, e.g. `Start`, `Last day to withdraw`
columns.applies_to: which term or session it applies to
columns.end: ISO date; set only for multi-day windows
columns.span_days: length of the window; null for single-day deadlines
columns.table: the table on the page it came from

tables.name: pages
tables.grain: one calendar page -- degree requirements, faculty overviews, admission rules, regulations. Everything the calendar publishes that is not a course

columns.title: page title
columns.kind: derived: degree_requirements, major, minor, admission, regulations, coop, advising, faculty_overview... what the page is
columns.level: derived: undergraduate, masters, doctoral or certificate
columns.program: derived: the degree this page sits inside, if any
columns.breadcrumbs: derived: the ancestor titles, recovered by matching alias prefixes
columns.referenced_courses: course codes the page mentions, in order, validated against this campus's subject vocabulary

people.title: Faculty and staff profiles by unit
people.description: Public faculty and staff profiles from UBC units on the shared Drupal platform, tagged with the site they came from. Coverage is partial -- most faculties run other platforms and expose no API, so `_sites.json` records which hosts answered. Public directory information only -- no student data.

tables.name: _sites
tables.grain: one host that was probed for profiles, whether or not it had any

columns.profiles: how many it returned; 0 means it is not on the shared platform
columns.skipped: why nothing came back, when nothing did

tables.name: profiles
tables.grain: one published faculty or staff profile on one UBC site

columns.title: the person's name as the site publishes it
columns.site: which UBC host published it -- the only unit marker there is
columns.alias: path on that host; prefix the host for the URL

joins: title ~ courses/sections.field_instructors (by name; there is no shared id)

services.title: Campus services (food, parking, facilities, student services, news)
services.description: Food outlets and their hours, parking locations, permits and parking maps, facilities and learning-space resource libraries, recreation and student services pages, UBC news posts, and the statutory holidays UBC observes.

reports.title: Institutional reports (finance, budget, enrolment, Facts & Figures)
reports.description: An index of UBC's published institutional documents -- annual financial reports, budgets, tuition and fee schedules, annual enrolment reports and Facts & Figures sheets -- with a direct download URL, file type and the source page for each, plus the underlying page content.

tables.name: documents
tables.grain: one published document, deduplicated across the pages that link it

columns.url: direct download; the document itself is not mirrored here
columns.filename: the file as UBC named it -- usually the only title it has
columns.page_title: the page it was linked from
columns.linked_from_pages: how many pages link it; a high count usually means boilerplate

finances.title: Tuition, student fees and first-year cost estimates
finances.description: What studying at UBC costs: per-credit tuition rates by program for domestic and international students including the cohort year each rate applies to, flat-rate and per-instalment programs, Board- and society-approved student fees, UBC's own first-year cost estimate for every program area with the housing, meal, rent and grocery figures behind it, and a per-program estimate derived by joining the two.

tables.name: cost_estimates
tables.grain: UBC's own first-year cost estimate for one program area

columns.area: the area as the estimator names it
columns.tuition_domestic: year-one tuition on a 30-credit load, CAD
columns.tuition_international: year-one tuition on a 30-credit load, CAD
columns.student_fees: year-one student fees (U-Pass, basic health insurance...)
columns.lab_clinic_fees_domestic: lab or clinic fees, where the area charges them
columns.lab_clinic_fees_international: lab or clinic fees, where the area charges them
columns.books_supplies: estimated books and supplies for the year
columns.custom_tuition_message: caveat UBC attaches to this area's figure

tables.name: fee_notes
tables.grain: one row from a fee table that carries no money -- footnotes, eligibility conditions and instalment counts, kept because they qualify the rates

tables.name: living_costs
tables.grain: one cost-of-living figure the estimator assumes

columns.variant: standard, or vantage_one where Vantage College differs
columns.basis: per_academic_year for housing and meal plans, per_month for the rest

tables.name: program_cost_estimates
tables.grain: one undergraduate program with the first-year cost of the area that prices it

columns.program: program name as the finder lists it
columns.degrees: degree names this program leads to; what the match usually ran on
columns.area: the cost-estimator area, e.g. `Land and Food Systems: Applied Biology`
columns.area_key: the cost-estimator area matched to this program
columns.tuition_domestic: year-one tuition on a 30-credit load, CAD
columns.tuition_international: year-one tuition on a 30-credit load, CAD
columns.books_supplies: estimated books and supplies for the year
columns.matched_by: how the match was made -- exact or overlap, on the program title or on one of its degrees. Programs with no unique area are in _unmatched.json rather than here
columns.educational_total_domestic: derived: tuition + fees + lab + books for year one
columns.educational_total_international: derived: tuition + fees + lab + books for year one

tables.name: student_fees
tables.grain: one student fee as charged to one category of student

columns.item: the fee, e.g. `Athletics and Recreation Fee`
columns.column: who pays it, e.g. `Undergraduate and Certificates Full-Time`
columns.section: the heading above the table; says whether the Board of Governors or a student society sets the fee

tables.name: tuition
tables.grain: one tuition figure: a program, a column of the table it came from, and what that column charges

columns.level: undergraduate, certificate_diploma, masters, doctoral, vantage_college or dual_degree -- from the page the rate is on
columns.program: program the rate applies to, with any year band removed
columns.applies_to: the year band, e.g. `Years 2 to 5`, when the rate is banded
columns.cohort_year: intake year the rate is frozen at; international rates only
columns.cohort_rule: exactly, or_later or or_earlier -- how to read cohort_year
columns.annual_at_30_credits: derived: amount x 30, for per-credit rates only. 30 credits is a full-time year and the load UBC's own estimator uses
columns.amount_text: the cell as UBC wrote it
columns.item: the row label, verbatim; empty when the row had no label
columns.context: rows above the header inside the same table -- on the graduate pages this is where the program name and instalment count live
columns.table_label: the table's own first cell, which is what `program` is usually taken from
columns.divider: the in-table row heading the amount sits under, e.g. `2026S or 2026W`

joins: program ~ finances/program_cost_estimates.area (by name, not an id)

bookings.title: Library room availability (bookable spaces and free time)
bookings.description: Every bookable space in UBC Library's LibCal with its location, capacity and photo, and when each one is free, booked or unavailable over UBC's booking window -- the 15-minute grid UBC publishes, merged into intervals. Availability is a snapshot taken at `collected_at`, not a standing fact; see _snapshot.json for the window covered.

tables.name: availability
tables.grain: One uninterrupted stretch of one room in one state, as it stood at `collected_at` -- UBC's consecutive 15-minute slots merged.

columns.state: `free`, `booked`, or `unavailable`. Anything UBC marks in a way this collector does not recognise is reported `unavailable`, never `free`. Filter on `free` to find bookable time.
columns.start: First moment in this state, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` local, as UBC sends it; `end` is the first moment no longer in it.
columns.minutes: Length of the stretch, so a usable block can be picked without subtracting timestamps.
columns.collected_at: When this snapshot was taken. Availability moves; this does not.

tables.name: locations
tables.grain: One LibCal location -- a UBC library or branch that publishes bookable space.

columns.lid: LibCal location id; the key rooms and slots carry.
columns.name: Library name as UBC's own dropdown gives it.
columns.building_code: BLDG_CODE of the building it sits in, for the geospatial join.
columns.rooms_collected: Rooms found for this location on this run.
columns.total_capacity: Seats across those rooms, where capacity is published.

tables.name: rooms
tables.grain: One bookable space -- a group study room, project room or seating area.

columns.eid: LibCal space id. The same number the availability grid calls `itemId`.
columns.lid: The location this room belongs to.
columns.capacity: Seats, where UBC publishes them; null for spaces that are not individually bookable.
columns.building_code: Inherited from the location, for the geospatial join.
columns.described_by: `spaces_page` if the browsable list described this room, `space_page` if it only appeared in the grid and was filled in from its own page.
columns.filter_ids: LibCal's internal amenity filter ids, kept as sent.

grades.title: Course grade distributions (sections, averages, histograms)
grades.description: Every UBC Vancouver course section with a reported grade distribution: enrolment, average, median, percentiles, high/low, and the count of grades in each of the dashboard's percentage buckets, per term.
